title: Everyday Phrases — Meditation Practice
scene_zh: 冥想練習 · 情境對話
title_quote: Are you ready to meditate tonight?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧘 實用冥想練習必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Meditation Practice
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用冥想練習情境對話：把手機靜音、找安靜角落、鋪坐墊定十分鐘計時，到四拍吸六拍呼、念頭飄走再拉回、從頭到腳掃描身體、聽房間的聲音、計時結束慢慢睜眼伸懶腰喝溫水、記錄心情、躺著聽著入睡（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Meditation Practice phrase pairs, from silencing your phone, finding a quiet corner and setting a ten-minute timer, to breathing in for four and out for six, scanning the body head to toe, and drifting off with a warm drink after the bell (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready to meditate tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ər ju ˈrɛdi tu ˈmɛdəˌteɪt təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你今晚準備好冥想了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us begin right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, lɛt ʌs bɪˈɡɪn raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我們現在就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should we sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʃʊd wi sɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該坐多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes is plenty for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪz ˈplɛnti fər ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘對我們剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, silence the phone first.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈsaɪələns ðə foʊn fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 好，先把手機靜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, no calls tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, noʊ kɔlz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，今晚不接電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn the lights off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɜrn ðə laɪts ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把燈關掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep one small lamp on.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt kip wʌn smɔl læmp ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 好，但留一盞小燈亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this corner quiet enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈkɔrnər ˈkwaɪət ɪˈnʌf?/
dialogue.zh: 這個角落夠安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels soft and very peaceful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz sɔft ænd ˈvɛri ˈpisfəl./
dialogue.zh: 這裡感覺柔軟又安寧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we put the cushion?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi pʊt ðə ˈkʊʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 坐墊要放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it flat on the floor here.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt flæt ɑn ðə flɔr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 平放在這裡的地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor feels a bit cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr filz ə bɪt koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 地板感覺有點涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold a blanket under your legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ə ˈblæŋkɪt ˈʌndər jʊr lɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 把毛毯摺起來墊在腿下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a chair instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ʧɛr ɪnˈstɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要改用椅子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A chair is fine, just sit tall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʧɛr ɪz faɪn, dʒʌst sɪt tɔl./
dialogue.zh: 椅子也可以，坐直就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lean against the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ lin əˈɡɛnst ðə wɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以靠著牆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep your back straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt kip jʊr bæk streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過背要保持挺直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting straight already feels strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ streɪt ɔlˈrɛdi filz streɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 坐直這件事已經感覺怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It eases after two slow breaths.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈizəz ˈæftər tu sloʊ brɛθs./
dialogue.zh: 兩次慢呼吸後就自在了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What clothes should I wear?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt kloʊz ʃʊd aɪ wɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我該穿什麼衣服？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear something loose and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ˈsʌmθɪŋ lus ænd wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 穿寬鬆又保暖的衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These jeans feel too tight today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz dʒinz fil tu taɪt təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 牛仔褲今天感覺太緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change into soft cotton pants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʧeɪnʤ ˈɪntu sɔft ˈkɑtn pænts./
dialogue.zh: 換成柔軟的棉質長褲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take my socks off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk maɪ sɑks ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把襪子脫掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them on, warm feet help.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm ɑn, wɔrm fit hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 穿著吧，腳暖暖比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, I will set a ten minute timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, aɪ wɪl sɛt ə tɛn ˈmɪnət ˈtaɪmər./
dialogue.zh: 我先設一個十分鐘的計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the soft bell, not the loud one.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə sɔft bɛl, nɑt ðə laʊd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 用輕柔的鐘聲，不要大聲的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that timer vibrate too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt ˈtaɪmər ˈvaɪˌbreɪt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 那個計時器也會震動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the bell, nothing loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə bɛl, ˈnʌθɪŋ laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 只有鐘聲，沒有大聲的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I place my hands?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ pleɪs maɪ hændz?/
dialogue.zh: 我的手該放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them gently on your knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛm ˈdʒɛntli ɑn jʊr niz./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕放在膝蓋上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my shoulders up too high?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ʌp tu haɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀聳得太高了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let them drop down slowly now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðɛm drɑp daʊn ˈsloʊli naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在讓它們慢慢垂下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my chin a little tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ʧɪn ə ˈlɪtəl taɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的下巴有點繃緊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soften it, lips closed, jaw loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔfn ɪt, lɪps kloʊzd, dʒɔ lus./
dialogue.zh: 放鬆，嘴唇輕閉，下巴鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my eyes stay open or not?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ aɪz steɪ ˈoʊpən ɔr nɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛要睜著還是閉著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close them softly, with no pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðɛm ˈsɔftli, wɪθ noʊ ˈprɛʃər./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕閉上，不要用力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room smells like clean cotton.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum smɛlz laɪk klin ˈkɑtn./
dialogue.zh: 房間有乾淨棉布的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, it helps us settle in.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ɪt hɛlps ʌs ˈsɛtəl ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 真好，幫我們安定下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I light the small candle?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ laɪt ðə smɔl ˈkændəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以點那個小蠟燭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, blow it out when we finish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, bloʊ ɪt aʊt wɛn wi ˈfɪnɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 好，結束時記得吹熄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the window better closed tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈbɛtər kloʊzd təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚窗戶關起來比較好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the street is still loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə strit ɪz stɪl laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 對，外面街上還很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cat wants to sit with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kæt wɑnts tu sɪt wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 我的貓想跟我們一起坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let her stay, she is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɚ steɪ, ʃi ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 讓牠留下來，牠很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you move the ticking clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju muv ðə ˈtɪkɪŋ klɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 你把會嘀嗒的鐘移走了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it ticks in the kitchen now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt tɪks ɪn ðə ˈkɪʧən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，現在它在廚房嘀嗒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I feel a little restless already.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, aɪ fil ə ˈlɪtəl ˈrɛstləs ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我已經有點坐不住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal, begin very slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl, bɪˈɡɪn ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 很正常，非常慢地開始就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I sitting too stiff right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈsɪtɪŋ tu stɪf raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在坐得太僵硬了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sway once, then find your center.
dialogue.phonetic: /sweɪ wʌns, ðɛn faɪnd jʊr ˈsɛntər./
dialogue.zh: 前後搖一下，再找到重心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the timer waits by my knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðə ˈtaɪmər weɪts baɪ maɪ niz./
dialogue.zh: 好，計時器擱在我膝邊等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One soft bell, and then we begin.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɔft bɛl, ænd ðɛn wi bɪˈɡɪn./
dialogue.zh: 一聲輕鐘，然後我們就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I ask one thing first?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ æsk wʌn θɪŋ fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我能先問一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we still have a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, wi stɪl hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們還有一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cushion holds my hips well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkʊʃən hoʊldz maɪ hɪps wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 這個坐墊穩穩托住我的臀部。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your body feels safe here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, jʊr ˈbɑdi filz seɪf hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 真好，身體在這裡覺得安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp gives a warm glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ɡɪvz ə wɔrm gloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 燈光散發溫暖的光暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for sleepy, quiet eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt fər ˈsliːpi, ˈkwaɪət aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 最適合想睡的安靜眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, my phone is out in the hall now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, maɪ foʊn ɪz aʊt ɪn ðə hɔl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 哦，我把手機放到外面廳裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, no screens before bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, noʊ skrinz bɪˈfɔr bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，睡前不碰螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is ten minutes too short to start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz tɛn ˈmɪnɪts tu ʃɔrt tu stɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 從十分鐘開始會不會太短？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short is easy, easy keeps going.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt ɪz ˈizi, ˈizi kips ˈɡoʊɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 短才容易，容易才堅持得下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I cleared the space by the bookshelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, aɪ klɪrd ðə speɪs baɪ ðə ˈbʊkˌʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 我把書架旁邊清出了一塊空地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That corner looks so calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkɔrnər lʊks soʊ kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 那個角落看起來好平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sweater feels soft on my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈswɛtər filz sɔft ɑn maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 毛衣碰到脖子很柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfort matters more than looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmfərt ˈmætərz mɔr ðæn lʊks./
dialogue.zh: 舒適比好看更重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I cross my legs or not?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ krɔs maɪ lɛɡz ɔr nɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 我要盤腿還是不要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whichever feels easier for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪʧɛvər filz ˈizɪər fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 哪一種讓你更輕鬆就選哪一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knee taps when I get impatient.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ni tæps wɛn aɪ ɡɛt ˌɪmˈpeɪʃənt./
dialogue.zh: 我不耐煩的時候膝蓋會抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Place one hand on that knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪs wʌn hænd ɑn ðæt ni./
dialogue.zh: 把一隻手放到那只膝蓋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door is shut, the room is ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr ɪz ʃʌt, ðə rum ɪz ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 門關好了，這個房間是我們自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No one will knock tonight, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wʌn wɪl nɑk təˈnaɪt, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想今晚沒人會敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take my watch off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk maɪ wɑʧ ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把手錶摘下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, remove anything tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, rɪˈmuv ˈɛniθɪŋ taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，凡是緊的都拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my hair is tied back loosely.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ hɛr ɪz taɪd bæk ˈlusli./
dialogue.zh: 現在我頭髮鬆鬆綁在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, nothing itches your cheek now.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈɪʧɪz jʊr ʧik naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 真好，臉頰就不會發癢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I ready to close my eyes?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈrɛdi tu kloʊz maɪ aɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 我準備好閉上眼睛了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are, the timer is set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr, ðə ˈtaɪmər ɪz sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，計時已經設好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air here feels slower already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɛr hɪr filz ˈsloʊər ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的空氣已經慢了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room helps us breathe easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum hɛlps ʌs brið ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 這個房間在幫我們輕鬆呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I whisper a word first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈwɪspər ə wɜrd fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我要先小聲說一句話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just breathe out once, very slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst brið aʊt wʌns, ˈvɛri sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 先吐一口氣，非常慢地吐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blanket is folded on my lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz ˈfoʊldəd ɑn maɪ læp./
dialogue.zh: 毛毯摺好放在我的腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm legs keep us from shaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm lɛɡz kip ʌs frəm ˈʃeɪkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 腿暖暖的就不會發抖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the timer set to ten minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtaɪmər sɛt tu tɛn ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 計時設的是十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but stop early if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt stɑp ˈɜrli ɪf ˈnidəd./
dialogue.zh: 對，需要時也可以提早停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, nothing here is forced at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ˈnʌθɪŋ hɪr ɪz fɔrst æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 真好，這裡什麼都不勉強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, we only sit and notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, wi ˈoʊnli sɪt ænd ˈnoʊtɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們只是坐著、覺察。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me move this box off the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi muv ðɪs bɑks ɑf ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 讓我先把紙箱從地板上移開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we have space for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi hæv speɪs fər tu./
dialogue.zh: 現在夠我們兩個人坐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we sit facing the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi sɪt ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要面著門坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit however feels easy to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ˈhaʊˌɛvər filz ˈizi tu ju./
dialogue.zh: 怎麼輕鬆就怎麼坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set my glasses on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt maɪ ˈɡlæsəz ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我把眼鏡放在桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your eyes can fully rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, jʊr aɪz kæn ˈfʊli rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 好，你的眼睛能完全休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is our new quiet corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˈaʊər nuː ˈkwaɪət ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 這是我們新的安靜角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already feel my breath slow down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi fil maɪ brɛθ sloʊ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我已經感覺呼吸變慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I press start: one soft bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛs stɑrt: wʌn sɔft bɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我按下開始：一聲輕鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, eyes closed, I am here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪz kloʊzd, aɪ æm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 好，閉上眼，我在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe in through your nose now.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ɪn θru jʊr noʊz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在用鼻子吸氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, and it feels cool and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn, ænd ɪt filz kul ænd sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 吸進來，感覺涼涼又慢慢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count to four while you breathe in.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt tu fɔr waɪl ju brið ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 吸氣的時候數到四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four, nice and easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn, tu, θri, fɔr, naɪs ænd ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三、四，輕鬆慢慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now breathe out for six slow counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ brið aʊt fər sɪks sloʊ kaʊnts./
dialogue.zh: 現在呼氣，慢慢數到六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One to six, my breath goes far.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu sɪks, maɪ brɛθ goʊz fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 數到六，我的氣息拉得很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Longer out than in, that is the key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔŋɡər aʊt ðæn ɪn, ðæt ɪz ðə ki./
dialogue.zh: 呼氣比吸氣長，這就是要訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My chest already feels less tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʧɛst ɔlˈrɛdi filz lɛs taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的胸口已經沒那麼緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my belly move when I breathe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ ˈbɛli muv wɛn aɪ brið?/
dialogue.zh: 呼吸的時候肚子要動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let it rise and fall softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, lɛt ɪt raɪz ænd fɔl ˈsɔftli./
dialogue.zh: 要，讓它輕輕地起伏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, my hands are warming up already.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, maɪ hændz ɑr ˈwɔrmɪŋ ʌp ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 哦，我的雙手已經開始變暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means your body is relaxing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz jʊr ˈbɑdi ɪz rɪˈlækˌsɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那代表你的身體在放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let your shoulders fall away now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz fɔl əˈweɪ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在讓肩膀往下鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They were up by my ears, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr wɜr ʌp baɪ maɪ ɪrz, hʌ./
dialogue.zh: 它們剛剛都聳到耳邊了呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest your tongue softly down.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jʊr tʌŋ ˈsɔftli daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 讓舌頭輕輕放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did not know I held it there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ aɪ hɛld ɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我都不知道它一直緊貼著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relax your forehead, all of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks jʊr ˈfɔrˌhɛd, ɔl ʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 放鬆你的額頭，整個鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My whole face feels heavy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊl feɪs filz ˈhɛvi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我整張臉都感覺沉沉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thoughts came in, many of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɔts keɪm ɪn, ˈmɛni ʌv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 念頭跑進來了，還不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notice them, then return to breathing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪs ðɛm, ðɛn rɪˈtɜrn tu ˈbriðɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 看見它們，再回到呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mind keeps making lists for tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ maɪnd kips ˈmeɪkɪŋ lɪsts fər təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 腦子還在替明天列清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write them later, not right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðɛm ˈleɪtər, nɑt raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒再寫，現在不管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, I keep drifting away from the count.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, aɪ kip ˈdrɪftɪŋ əˈweɪ frəm ðə kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 可是我一直從數拍裡飄走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back gently, start at one again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk ˈdʒɛntli, stɑrt æt wʌn əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕回來，重新從一開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I doing this wrong tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈduɪŋ ðɪs rɔŋ təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚這樣做是錯的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, noticing is doing it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈnoʊtɪsɪŋ ɪz ˈduɪŋ ɪt raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不，能察覺就是做對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I feel bad about all the wandering.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ fil bæd əˈbaʊt ɔl ðə ˈwɑndərɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 但我對自己的胡思亂想很難過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Be kind, no judging here tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /bi kaɪnd, noʊ ˈdʒʌdʒɪŋ hɪr təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 要溫柔，今晚這裡不評判。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting helps me stay in place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ hɛlps mi steɪ ɪn pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 數拍讓我能待在原地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the numbers as your anchor, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈnʌmbərz æz jʊr ˈæŋkər ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就把數字當成你的錨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inhale four: one, two, three, four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈheɪl fɔr: wʌn, tu, θri, fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 吸氣四拍：一、二、三、四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exhale six and let it all go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛksˈheɪl sɪks ænd lɛt ɪt ɔl goʊ./
dialogue.zh: 呼氣六拍，全部放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my breathing too shallow right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈbriðɪŋ tu ˈʃæloʊ raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在的呼吸太淺了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deeper is fine, but never force it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdipər ɪz faɪn, bʌt ˈnɛvər fɔrs ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 深一點沒問題，但不要勉強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose feels a little blocked.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ noʊz filz ə ˈlɪtəl blɑkt./
dialogue.zh: 我的鼻子有點不太通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe through your mouth then, softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið θru jʊr maʊθ ðɛn, ˈsɔftli./
dialogue.zh: 那就用嘴巴輕輕呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each out breath loosens my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /iʧ aʊt brɛθ ˈlusənz maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 每一次吐氣都讓脖子鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, let the head hang heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, lɛt ðə hɛd hæŋ ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 好，讓頭沉甸甸地垂著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A thought about dinner floated by.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɔt əˈbaʊt ˈdɪnər ˈfloʊtəd baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一個關於晚餐的念頭飄過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch it go, like a small cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʧ ɪt goʊ, laɪk ə smɔl klaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 看著它飄走，像一朵小雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I lost the count twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, aɪ lɔst ðə kaʊnt twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我已經數丟兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine, begin once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn, bɪˈɡɪn wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，重新來一次就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulder blades feel pressed and tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃoʊldər bleɪdz fil prɛst ænd taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的肩胛骨感覺又壓又緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe into your back, widen the ribs.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ˈɪntu jʊr bæk, ˈwaɪdən ðə rɪbz./
dialogue.zh: 往背部呼吸，讓肋骨展開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I hold my breath sometimes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ hoʊld maɪ brɛθ ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz?/
dialogue.zh: 我有時需要屏住呼吸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep the air moving slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, kip ði ɛr ˈmuvɪŋ sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不用，讓空氣慢慢流動就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four in, six out, again together.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɪn, sɪks aʊt, əˈɡɛn təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 四拍吸、六拍呼，一起再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, and out, that was nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn, ænd aʊt, ðæt wɑz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 吸氣，再呼氣，這樣真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mind wants quiet, my body too.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ maɪnd wɑnts ˈkwaɪət, maɪ ˈbɑdi tu./
dialogue.zh: 我的腦子想安靜，身體也想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let the breath carry both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ðə brɛθ ˈkæri boʊθ ʌv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 那就讓氣息帶著我們兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess what, my belly made a sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛs wʌt, maɪ ˈbɛli meɪd ə saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 你猜怎麼著，我的肚子叫了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is okay, bodies make sounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz oʊˈkeɪ, ˈbɑdiz meɪk saʊndz./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，身體本來就會有聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I breathing too fast again?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈbriðɪŋ tu fæst əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我又呼吸太快了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow the last half of each out.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ðə læst hæf ʌv iʧ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 把每一次吐氣的後半放慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soften your belly on the out breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔfn jʊr ˈbɛli ɑn ði ˈaʊt brɛθ./
dialogue.zh: 吐氣的時候讓肚子軟下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drops a little every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt drɑps ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɛvri taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 它每次都往下沉一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No plans, no tasks, just this breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ plænz, noʊ tæsks, dʒʌst ðɪs brɛθ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有計畫、沒有工作，只有這口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That thought helped me relax more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt θɔt hɛlpt mi rɪˈlæks mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 你這句話讓我更放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thoughts are loud tonight, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θɔts ɑr laʊd təˈnaɪt, ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我的念頭很吵，唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not fight them, just breathe through.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt faɪt ðɛm, dʒʌst brið θru./
dialogue.zh: 不要跟它們對抗，帶著呼吸就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tried to push the thoughts away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ traɪd tu pʊʃ ðə θɔts əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我試著把念頭推開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pushing makes them louder, let them sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ meɪks ðɛm ˈlaʊdər, lɛt ðɛm sɪt./
dialogue.zh: 越推越吵，讓它們坐著吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four slow counts, and the pause after.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr sloʊ kaʊnts, ænd ðə pɔz ˈæftər./
dialogue.zh: 慢數四拍，之後停一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That tiny pause feels so calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtaɪni pɔz filz soʊ kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 那個小小的停頓好平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six counts out, my sigh came free.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks kaʊnts aʊt, maɪ saɪ keɪm fri./
dialogue.zh: 吐氣六拍，一聲嘆息自己出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it out again, it releases stress.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt aʊt əˈɡɛn, ɪt rɪˈlisɪz strɛs./
dialogue.zh: 再吐一次，它能釋放壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my jaw still tight up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ dʒɔ stɪl taɪt ʌp ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的下顎還緊緊咬著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unclench it, leave a little space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈklɛnʧ ɪt, liv ə ˈlɪtəl speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 鬆開，上下牙之間留點縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To be honest, I compared us a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bi ˈɑnɪst, aɪ kəmˈpɛrd ʌs ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我有點拿我們倆比較。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your pace is the only right pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr peɪs ɪz ði ˈoʊnli raɪt peɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你的步調就是唯一對的步調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting my breaths feels easier now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ maɪ brɛθs filz ˈizɪər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在數呼吸覺得容易多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the body learns very fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə ˈbɑdi lɜrnz ˈvɛri fæst./
dialogue.zh: 看吧，身體學得非常快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halfway already, did you notice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ ɔlˈrɛdi, dɪd ju ˈnoʊtɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 已經一半了，你有發現嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, time feels soft here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈrɪli, taɪm filz sɔft hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有耶，時間在這裡變得柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers feel tingly and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz fil ˈtɪŋli ænd wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 我的手指麻麻的、暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let them open a little wider.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðɛm ˈoʊpən ə ˈlɪtəl ˈwaɪdər./
dialogue.zh: 讓手指再張開一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep my mouth closed while breathing?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kip maɪ maʊθ kloʊzd waɪl ˈbriðɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 呼吸時嘴巴要閉著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, the nose filters air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli jɛs, ðə noʊz ˈfɪltərz ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 通常是的，鼻子會過濾空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every few rounds, the count slips away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri fju raʊndz, ðə kaʊnt slɪps əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 每過幾輪，數字就悄悄溜走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start fresh, nothing is lost at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt frɛʃ, ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz lɔst æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 重新開始就好，什麼都沒失去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mind went quiet for a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ maɪnd wɛnt ˈkwaɪət fər ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的腦子安靜了整整一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the practice, stay longer there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈpræktɪs, steɪ ˈlɔŋɡər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那就是練習，試著多待一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing out slowly feels best to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbriðɪŋ aʊt ˈsloʊli filz bɛst tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 把吐氣放慢的感覺最舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tells the body it is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɛlz ðə ˈbɑdi ɪt ɪz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 它在告訴身體：這裡很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep counting or just feel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip ˈkaʊntɪŋ ɔr dʒʌst fil?/
dialogue.zh: 我要繼續數，還是只要感受？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Switch whenever one feels heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪʧ wɛnˈɛvər wʌn filz ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 哪一種讓你費力就換另一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chest feels wide and open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʧɛst filz waɪd ænd ˈoʊpən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的胸口現在覺得寬闊打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beautiful, keep those shoulders down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbjutəfəl, kip ðoʊz ˈʃoʊldərz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 真好，肩膀繼續往下沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more minutes of counting only.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr ˈmɪnɪts ʌv ˈkaʊntɪŋ ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 再數兩分鐘的呼吸就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In four, out six, easy does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn fɔr, aʊt sɪks, ˈizi dʌz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 四拍進、六拍出，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A worry knocked, I did not answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwɜri nɑkt, aɪ dɪd nɑt ˈænsər./
dialogue.zh: 一個擔心來敲門，我沒有應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nicely done, that is real skill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪsli dʌn, ðæt ɪz ril skɪl./
dialogue.zh: 做得漂亮，這是真的功力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My breath is quieter than before.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ brɛθ ɪz ˈkwaɪətər ðæn bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我的呼吸比剛剛更輕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it be tiny, no need to fix it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt bi ˈtaɪni, noʊ nid tu fɪks ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 讓它小小的，不用刻意調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Being still is harder than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbiɪŋ stɪl ɪz ˈhɑrdər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 保持不動比我想像的難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, you are doing it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, ju ɑr ˈduɪŋ ɪt wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 不過，你已經做得很好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost done with the breathing part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst dʌn wɪð ðə ˈbriðɪŋ pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 呼吸的部分快要結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we scan the body next.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi skæn ðə ˈbɑdi nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 對，接著掃描身體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bells: the breathing part is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɛlz: ðə ˈbriðɪŋ pɑrt ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 鐘響兩聲：呼吸的部分結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, eyes still softly closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪz stɪl ˈsɔftli kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 好，眼睛繼續輕輕閉著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start the scan at your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt ðə skæn æt jʊr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我們從頭部開始掃描。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I feel my scalp now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ fil maɪ skæp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我感覺到我的頭皮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now move down to your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ muv daʊn tu jʊr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 現在往下移到眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They rest heavy in their sockets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ rɛst ˈhɛvi ɪn ðɛr ˈsɑkɪts./
dialogue.zh: 眼皮沉沉地窩在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notice your cheeks and your ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪs jʊr ʧiks ænd jʊr ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 注意一下你的臉頰和耳朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My cheeks went soft by themselves.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʧiks wɛnt sɔft baɪ ðɛmˈsɛlvz./
dialogue.zh: 臉頰自己就變柔軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let the mouth area go loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðə maʊθ ˈɛriə ɡoʊ lus./
dialogue.zh: 讓嘴巴周圍鬆開來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My lips parted a tiny bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɪps ˈpɑrtəd ə ˈtaɪni bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴唇微微分開了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now your neck, both sides of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ jʊr nɛk, boʊθ saɪdz ʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 現在是脖子，兩邊都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels long and warm there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz lɔŋ ænd wɔrm ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那個地方感覺又長又暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoulders down, arms heavy like logs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz daʊn, ɑrmz ˈhɛvi laɪk lɔɡz./
dialogue.zh: 肩膀下沉，手臂沉得像木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine sank along my sides already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sæŋk əˈlɔŋ maɪ saɪdz ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我的已經垂落在身側了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring your attention to your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jʊr əˈtɛnʃən tu jʊr hændz./
dialogue.zh: 把注意力帶到雙手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel pulses in my fingertips.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈpʌlsəz ɪn maɪ ˈfɪŋəˌtɪps./
dialogue.zh: 我感覺到指尖在跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curl your fingers, then let them open.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɜrl jʊr ˈfɪŋɡərz, ðɛn lɛt ðɛm ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 手指捲一下，再張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are so much softer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr soʊ mʌʧ ˈsɔftər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它們現在軟了好多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scan your chest as it rises.
dialogue.phonetic: /skæn jʊr ʧɛst æz ɪt ˈraɪzɪz./
dialogue.zh: 掃描你不斷起伏的胸口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It moves like a slow wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt muvz laɪk ə sloʊ weɪv./
dialogue.zh: 它像慢慢的波浪一樣移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the belly, low and round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈbɛli, loʊ ænd raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 然後是肚子，低低的、圓圓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm, and it moves on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm, ænd ɪt muvz ɑn ɪts ˈoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 暖暖的，它自己就會動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feel where your back leans on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil wɛr jʊr bæk linz ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 感覺一下背靠著牆的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a small warm gap there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl wɔrm ɡæp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那裡有一點暖暖的隙縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the hips, then both thighs.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə hɪps, ðɛn boʊθ thaɪz./
dialogue.zh: 現在是臀部，然後是大腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My thighs feel heavy on the cushion.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ thaɪz fil ˈhɛvi ɑn ðə ˈkʊʃən./
dialogue.zh: 我的大腿壓在坐墊上沉沉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The knees need no work, just notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə niz nid noʊ wɜrk, dʒʌst ˈnoʊtɪs./
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋不用特別做什麼，只要察覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I feel them resting now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ fil ðɛm ˈrɛstɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我感覺它們在休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down to the calves and ankles.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn tu ðə kævdz ænd ˈæŋkəlz./
dialogue.zh: 再往下到小腿和腳踝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little tingle in my left calf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈtɪŋɡəl ɪn maɪ lɛft kæf./
dialogue.zh: 我的左小腿有點麻麻的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finish at the toes, both feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃ æt ðə toʊz, boʊθ fit./
dialogue.zh: 最後到腳趾，兩隻腳都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They feel far away and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ fil fɑr əˈweɪ ænd wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 它們感覺遠遠的、暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that scan too quick for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt skæn tu kwɪk fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛那次掃描對你太快了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it felt slow and clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt fɛlt sloʊ ænd klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，感覺又慢又清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us hear the room sounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛt ʌs hɪr ðə rum saʊndz./
dialogue.zh: 現在來聽聽房間裡的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear the fridge hum downstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ðə frɪdʒ hʌm ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 我聽到樓下冰箱的嗡嗡聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also a car far on the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ə kɑr fɑr ɑn ðə strit./
dialogue.zh: 還有遠處街上的車子聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not name them, let them pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt neɪm ðɛm, lɛt ðɛm pæs./
dialogue.zh: 不用替它們貼標籤，讓它們過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear the clock ticking again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ðə klɑk ˈtɪkɪŋ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我又聽見那個鐘在嘀嗒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it as a soft rhythm, it is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt æz ə sɔft ˈrɪðəm, ɪt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 把它當成輕柔的節奏吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can sounds be part of the practice?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn saʊndz bi pɑrt ʌv ðə ˈpræktɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 聲音也能是練習的一部分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, listen without chasing anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈlɪsən wɪˈðaʊt ˈʧeɪsɪŋ ˈɛniθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，聽但不去追任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind tapped the window once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɪnd tæpt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 風輕輕敲了一下窗戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, the room keeps us company.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ðə rum kips ʌs ˈkʌmpəni./
dialogue.zh: 真好，房間陪著我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now count ten breaths, keep them slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ kaʊnt tɛn brɛθs, kip ðɛm sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在數十次呼吸，保持慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, out, one, in, out, two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn, aʊt, wʌn, ɪn, aʊt, tu./
dialogue.zh: 吸、吐，一；吸、吐，二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Near number six, I lost the count.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr ˈnʌmbər sɪks, aɪ lɔst ðə kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 數到六附近，我就數丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return to one, no harm at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜrn tu wʌn, noʊ hɑrm æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 回到一，完全沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I count out loud this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kaʊnt aʊt laʊd ðɪs taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這次我要唸出聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A whisper is fine if it helps you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwɪspər ɪz faɪn ɪf ɪt hɛlps ju./
dialogue.zh: 小聲唸也可以，只要有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs started to fall asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ˈstɑrtəd tu fɔl əˈslip./
dialogue.zh: 我的腿開始發麻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shift them slowly, do not rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɪft ðɛm ˈsloʊli, du nɑt rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢挪一下，不要太急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stretched one leg out a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ strɛtʃt wʌn lɛɡ aʊt ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 我把一隻腿伸出去一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, comfort beats perfect posture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ˈkʌmfərt bits ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈpɑstʃər./
dialogue.zh: 好，舒適勝過標準姿勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do numb legs mean I should stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /du nʌm lɛɡz min aɪ ʃʊd stɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 腿麻了代表我該停下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only stop if something really hurts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli stɑp ɪf ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈrɪli hɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 只有真的痛才要停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me turn onto my other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tɜrn ˈɑntu maɪ ˈʌðər saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我換到另一邊坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, there is no race.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm, ðɛr ɪz noʊ reɪs./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，這裡沒有比賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set both hands back on your knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt boʊθ hændz bæk ɑn jʊr niz./
dialogue.zh: 把兩隻手重新放回膝蓋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, the tingling is fading already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, ðə ˈtɪŋəlɪŋ ɪz ˈfeɪdɪŋ ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 你看，麻麻的感覺正在退掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feel your whole body sitting here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil jʊr hoʊl ˈbɑdi ˈsɪtɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 感受整個身體坐在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like one long breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz laɪk wʌn lɔŋ brɛθ./
dialogue.zh: 它感覺就像一口很長的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head keeps nodding, I am sleepy.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd kips ˈnɑdɪŋ, aɪ æm ˈsliːpi./
dialogue.zh: 我的頭一直在點，我好睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straighten it lightly, sleep comes after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstreɪtən ɪt ˈlaɪtli, slip kʌmz ˈæftər./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕扶正，睡覺是練習之後的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it all right to yawn a lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ɔl ˈraɪt tu jɔn ə lɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 一直打哈欠沒關係嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, yawning means you are relaxing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈjɔnɪŋ minz ju ɑr rɪˈlækˌsɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，哈欠代表你在放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I feel my heartbeat in my chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ fil maɪ ˈhɑrtˌbeɪt ɪn maɪ ʧɛst./
dialogue.zh: 現在我感覺到胸口的心跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady and calm, just watch it beat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi ænd kɑm, dʒʌst wɑʧ ɪt bit./
dialogue.zh: 平穩又安寧，就看著它跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we scan once more together?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi skæn wʌns mɔr təˈɡɛðər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要再一起掃描一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, start again at the very top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, stɑrt əˈɡɛn æt ðə ˈvɛri tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，再從最上面開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This time everything melts faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs taɪm ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ mɛlts ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 這一次每個地方都鬆得快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arms went heavy right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz wɛnt ˈhɛvi raɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我的手臂一下子就變得很沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I play soft music with this?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ pleɪ sɔft ˈmjuzɪk wɪð ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以搭配輕音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight keep it quiet, music tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt kip ɪt ˈkwaɪət, ˈmjuzɪk təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚先安靜，音樂留給明天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The quiet feels bigger than before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkwaɪət filz ˈbɪɡər ðæn bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 安靜的感覺比剛剛更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our ears need time for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈaʊər ɪrz nid taɪm fər ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我們的耳朵需要一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, my feet are cold again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, maɪ fit ɑr koʊld əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我的腳又涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide the blanket over your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ˈoʊvər jʊr fit./
dialogue.zh: 把毯子拉過去蓋住腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The warmth spread down both my legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔrmθ sprɛd daʊn boʊθ maɪ lɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 暖意順著我的兩條腿傳下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, small fixes really help.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, smɔl ˈfɪksəz ˈrɪli hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 看吧，小小的調整很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my face feels calm right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən maɪ feɪs filz kɑm raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 連我的臉都覺得平靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it alone, do not manage it.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt əˈloʊn, du nɑt ˈmænɪdʒ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用理它，不要去控制表情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my ears feel relaxed today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən maɪ ɪrz fil rɪˈlækst təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 連耳朵都覺得放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a good sign, rest there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd saɪn, rɛst ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那是好徵兆，就在那裡休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count ten more breaths from your belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt tɛn mɔr brɛθs frʌm jʊr ˈbɛli./
dialogue.zh: 從肚子再數十次呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five done, and I did not drift.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv dʌn, ænd aɪ dɪd nɑt drɪft./
dialogue.zh: 數完五次了，我沒有走神。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what if I lose a number?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, wʌt ɪf aɪ luz ə ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 那如果我又數錯一個數字呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then start at one, no problem at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stɑrt æt wʌn, noʊ ˈprɑbləm æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 那就從一重新開始，完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My whole body feels sunk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊl ˈbɑdi filz sʌŋk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我整個身體感覺沉下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let the floor take all your weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðə flɔr teɪk ɔl jʊr weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 讓地板承接你全部的重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, I hear only my own breath now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, aɪ hɪr ˈoʊnli maɪ oʊn brɛθ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我現在只聽見自己的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay with it, one more slow round.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ wɪð ɪt, wʌn mɔr sloʊ raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 守著它，再來一輪慢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my back aches a little from sitting.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, maɪ bæk eɪks ə ˈlɪtəl frʌm ˈsɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 哎，坐久了我的背有一點痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll it twice, then let it rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ɪt twaɪs, ðɛn lɛt ɪt rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 轉兩下，再讓它靠著休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room is quieter now than before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum ɪz ˈkwaɪətər naʊ ðæn bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 這個房間現在比剛剛更安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe we are the ones who changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wi ɑr ðə wʌnz hu tʃeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 也許是我們自己變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the last three minutes of the scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə læst θri ˈmɪnɪts ʌv ðə skæn./
dialogue.zh: 現在是掃描的最後三分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am soft from my head to my toes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm sɔft frʌm maɪ hɛd tu maɪ toʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我從頭到腳趾都柔軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest your hands, palms facing up.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jʊr hændz, pɑmz ˈfeɪsɪŋ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 手放好，掌心朝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look so still, like they are sleeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk soʊ stɪl, laɪk ðeɪ ɑr ˈslipɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 它們靜靜的，像在睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three soft bells: the scan is finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri sɔft bɛlz: ðə skæn ɪz ˈfɪnɪʃt./
dialogue.zh: 三聲輕鐘：掃描結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still no rush, we sit a moment more.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl noʊ rʌʃ, wi sɪt ə ˈmoʊmənt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 還是別急，我們再多坐一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bell just rang, our time is up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛl dʒʌst ræŋ, ˈaʊər taɪm ɪz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 鐘剛響，我們的時間到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already? Please wait, I am still inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi? pliz weɪt, aɪ æm stɪl ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 已經到了嗎？再等等，我還在裡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, we do not jump up.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm, wi du nɑt dʒʌmp ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我們不要馬上跳起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still here, breathing nice and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl hɪr, ˈbriðɪŋ naɪs ænd sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我還在這裡，呼吸又穩又慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wiggle your fingers first, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪɡəl jʊr ˈfɪŋɡərz fɜrst, ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 先讓手指輕輕動一動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They woke up so slowly, it is funny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ woʊk ʌp soʊ ˈsloʊli, ɪt ɪz ˈfʌni./
dialogue.zh: 它們好慢才醒過來，真好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now move your toes inside your socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ muv jʊr toʊz ɪnˈsaɪd jʊr sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 現在讓腳趾在襪子裡動一動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My feet are warm again at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit ɑr wɔrm əˈɡɛn æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 我的腳終於又暖起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I open my eyes right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈoʊpən maɪ aɪz raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以睜開眼睛了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a little, let the light in slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl, lɛt ðə laɪt ɪn sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 只睜一點點，讓光慢慢進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp looks brighter than before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp lʊks ˈbraɪtər ðæn bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 台燈看起來比剛剛亮了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close them again for one soft second.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðɛm əˈɡɛn fər wʌn sɔft ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 再閉一下下，輕輕一秒就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eyes open now, blow the candle out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪz ˈoʊpən naʊ, bloʊ ðə ˈkændəl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 睜開眼，把蠟燭吹熄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the smoke curls up like a cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ðə smoʊk kɜrlz ʌp laɪk ə klaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 吹熄了，煙像雲一樣往上捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, let us lift our arms up high.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, lɛt ʌs lɪft ˈaʊər ɑrmz ʌp haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們把手臂高舉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ahh, that stretch feels so good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, ðæt strɛtʃ filz soʊ ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 啊，這個伸展好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Arch your back and yawn wide, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑrʧ jʊr bæk ænd jɔn waɪd, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請挺一下背，張大打個哈欠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, that yawn was very loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, ðæt jɔn wʌz ˈvɛri laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，那個哈欠好大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud yawning is allowed in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ˈjɔnɪŋ ɪz əˈlaʊd ɪn ðɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 這個房間允許大聲打哈欠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then here comes another one, oh my.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hɪr kʌmz əˈnʌðər wʌn, oʊ maɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那又來一個了，天啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do your legs feel after sitting?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du jʊr lɛɡz fil ˈæftər ˈsɪtɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 坐完之後你的腿感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit numb, but much better now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt nʌm, bʌt mʌʧ ˈbɛtər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 有一點發麻，不過好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly now, hold the wall and rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli naʊ, hoʊld ðə wɔl ænd raɪz./
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，扶著牆站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whoa, my head went light for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, maɪ hɛd wɛnt laɪt fər ə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 哇，我的頭暈了一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, breathe, then try again slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, brið, ðɛn traɪ əˈɡɛn ˈsloʊər./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，呼吸，再更慢地試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it worked, I am standing fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt wɜrkt, aɪ æm ˈstændɪŋ faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這次可以了，我站得穩穩的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is warm water by your cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wɔrm ˈwɔtər baɪ jʊr kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 你的杯子旁邊有溫水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, small sips feel best now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju, smɔl sɪps fil bɛst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，現在小口小口喝最舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that water too warm for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ˈwɔtər tu wɔrm fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 那杯水對你來說太燙了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it felt nice on my dry throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt fɛlt naɪs ɑn maɪ draɪ θroʊt./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，喉嚨乾乾的，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit back down, we write one quick line.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt bæk daʊn, wi raɪt wʌn kwɪk laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 再坐下來，我們寫短短一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About my mood or the practice?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt maɪ mud, ɔr ðə ˈpræktɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 寫心情，還是寫這次的練習？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write how you feel right now, one word.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt haʊ ju fil raɪt naʊ, wʌn wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 寫下你現在的感覺，一個字就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote calm, and it is true.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt kɑm, ænd ɪt ɪz tru./
dialogue.zh: 我寫了平靜，而且是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine says tired, in a good way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɛz ˈtaɪərd, ɪn ə ɡʊd weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我寫的是累，那種舒服的累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kind that pulls you right to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kaɪnd ðæt pʊlz ju raɪt tu slip./
dialogue.zh: 就是那種把人拉進夢裡的累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we keep these notes in one book?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi kip ðiz noʊts ɪn wʌn bʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 我們把筆記放在同一本書裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one page for every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn peɪdʒ fər ˈɛvri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，一晚寫一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your mind wander a lot tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd jʊr maɪnd ˈwɑndər ə lɑt təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚你的念頭跑了很多次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe twice, but I let them go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi twaɪs, bʌt aɪ lɛt ðɛm goʊ./
dialogue.zh: 大概兩次吧，我讓它們走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I almost gave up at minute three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli, aɪ ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɡeɪv ʌp æt ˈmɪnɪt θri./
dialogue.zh: 老實說，到第三分鐘我差點放棄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you stayed, that is what counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ju steɪd, ðæt ɪz wɑt kaʊnts./
dialogue.zh: 但你留下來了，那才算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow let us sit at nine again.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ lɛt ʌs sɪt æt naɪn əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 明天我們九點再坐一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time, same corner, same cushion.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm taɪm, seɪm ˈkɔrnər, seɪm ˈkʊʃən./
dialogue.zh: 同一時間、同一角落、同一個坐墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the same hour really help?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə seɪm ˈaʊər ˈrɪli hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 固定同一時間真的有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the body learns your routine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈbɑdi lɜrnz jʊr ruˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 有，身體會記住你的作息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss a night someday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ mɪs ə naɪt ˈsʌmˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果哪天我漏了一個晚上呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just begin the next night, nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst bɪˈɡɪn ðə nɛkst naɪt, ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 下一晚重新開始就好，別想太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we make it ten or fifteen minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi meɪk ɪt tɛn ɔr fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要坐十分還是十五分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep ten, it is easy to repeat.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip tɛn, ɪt ɪz ˈizi tu rɪˈpit./
dialogue.zh: 維持十分鐘，比較容易天天做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, this small night habit fits me.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ðɪs smɔl naɪt ˈhæbɪt fɪts mi./
dialogue.zh: 所以這個小小的夜間習慣很適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it closes the day so softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ˈkloʊzɪz ðə deɪ soʊ ˈsɔftli./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，它把一天輕輕收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we lie down and finish this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi laɪ daʊn ænd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們躺著把這段收尾好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please pull the blanket up for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pliz pʊl ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ʌp fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 好，幫我把毯子拉上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pillow feels cool under my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪloʊ filz kul ˈʌndər maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 枕頭在頭下涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let your arms rest flat at your sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt jʊr ɑrmz rɛst flæt æt jʊr saɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 讓兩臂平平放在身體兩側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bed soft enough for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bɛd sɔft ɪˈnʌf fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 床對你來說夠軟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very, my whole back sank right in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri, maɪ hoʊl bæk sæŋk raɪt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 非常軟，我的背整個陷進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now listen, do not talk anymore.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈlɪsən, du nɑt tɔk ˈɔnɪˌmɔr./
dialogue.zh: 現在聽就好，不用再說話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will follow my breathing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ wɪl ˈfɑloʊ maɪ ˈbriðɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在跟著自己的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let the breath be long and quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðə brɛθ bi lɔŋ ænd ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 讓呼吸變得更長、更安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, out, my eyes are already heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn, aʊt, maɪ aɪz ɑr ɔlˈrɛdi ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 吸、吐，我的眼皮已經很沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No counting now, only listening.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkaʊntɪŋ naʊ, ˈoʊnli ˈlɪsənɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在不用數了，只要聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The voices are so far and so kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈvɔɪsəz ɑr soʊ fɑr ænd soʊ kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 這些聲音好遠、好溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not try to sleep, just lie there.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt traɪ tu slip, dʒʌst laɪ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 不用努力睡，就躺著就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny, that made me relax more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni, ðæt meɪd mi rɪˈlæks mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 好笑，這樣我反而更鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let your legs sink into the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt jʊr lɛɡz sɪŋk ˈɪntu ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 讓兩條腿沉進床裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They went down like two warm stones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɛnt daʊn laɪk tu wɔrm stoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 它們像兩顆溫熱的石頭沉下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And just like that, my shoulders let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd dʒʌst laɪk ðæt, maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz lɛt ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 就這樣，我的肩膀完全鬆開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the face soft, too, if you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə feɪs sɔft, tu, ɪf ju kæn./
dialogue.zh: 臉也要繼續鬆鬆的，如果可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the words come in slow and far.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə wɜrdz kʌm ɪn sloʊ ænd fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 現在這些字又慢又遠地傳來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine, let them drift past.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn, lɛt ðɛm drɪft pæst./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，讓它們慢慢飄過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each sentence feels like a soft wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /iʧ ˈsɛntəns filz laɪk ə sɔft weɪv./
dialogue.zh: 每一句話都像一道柔軟的浪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It carries me away, almost there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkæriz mi əˈweɪ, ˈɔlˌmoʊst ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 它把我帶走，差不多就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your eyes closed all the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr jʊr aɪz kloʊzd ɔl ðə weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你的眼睛完全閉緊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the dark feels very gentle.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ðə dɑrk filz ˈvɛri ˈdʒɛntəl./
dialogue.zh: 是的，黑暗感覺很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lamp off now, the room is dim and soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /læmp ɔf naʊ, ðə rum ɪz dɪm ænd sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 燈關了，房間暗暗柔柔的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So dim, my eyes can barely stay open.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dɪm, maɪ aɪz kæn ˈbɛrli steɪ ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 好暗，我的眼睛快睜不開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And so the breathing slows all by itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd soʊ ðə ˈbriðɪŋ sloʊz ɔl baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 於是呼吸自己就慢下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do nothing now, and that feels good.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ˈnʌθɪŋ naʊ, ænd ðæt filz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我什麼都不做了，感覺很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear the rain on the roof?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɪr ðə reɪn ɑn ðə ruf?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽見屋頂上的雨聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soft taps, like a sleepy song.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɔft tæps, laɪk ə ˈsliːpi sɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 有，輕輕的敲，像一首想睡的歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let the song carry your last thoughts.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðə sɔŋ ˈkæri jʊr læst θɔts./
dialogue.zh: 讓這首歌帶走你最後的念頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are floating away, one by one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr ˈfloʊtɪŋ əˈweɪ, wʌn baɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 它們正一個一個飄走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn to my side or stay flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɜrn tu maɪ saɪd ɔr steɪ flæt?/
dialogue.zh: 我要側躺還是平躺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side feels best, hug the small pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪd filz bɛst, hʌɡ ðə smɔl ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 側躺最舒服，抱著小枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees drew up a little by themselves.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz dru ʌp ə ˈlɪtəl baɪ ðɛmˈsɛlvz./
dialogue.zh: 我的膝蓋自己微微蜷了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, let the body pick its shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, lɛt ðə ˈbɑdi pɪk ɪts ʃeɪp./
dialogue.zh: 好，讓身體自己選姿勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did the cushion go, I wonder.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ðə ˈkʊʃən ɡoʊ, aɪ ˈwʌndər./
dialogue.zh: 坐墊去哪裡了呢，真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are deep in the blankets now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr dip ɪn ðə ˈblæŋkɪts naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你現在深深埋進被子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your breathing growing slow too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz jʊr ˈbriðɪŋ ˈɡroʊɪŋ sloʊ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你的呼吸也慢慢變慢了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am almost gone, do not speak now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɡɔn, du nɑt spik naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我快要睡著了，現在別說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that better than counting sheep?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ˈbɛtər ðæn ˈkaʊntɪŋ ʃip?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣是不是比數羊更有用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, I am half asleep already.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌʧ ˈbɛtər, aɪ æm hæf əˈslip ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好太多，我已經睡著一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night to my quiet, sleepy friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt tu maɪ ˈkwaɪət, ˈsliːpi frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，送給我安靜又睏倦的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, same time tomorrow night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, seɪm taɪm təˈmɑroʊ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，明晚同一時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last breath out, and the day is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst brɛθ aʊt, ænd ðə deɪ ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 最後一口吐氣，一天就結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All I hear now is slow breathing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl aɪ hɪr naʊ ɪz sloʊ ˈbriðɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在只聽見慢慢的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes turned into a whole soft night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə hoʊl sɔft naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘變成了一整個柔軟的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not one word more, only sleep now.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt wʌn wɜrd mɔr, ˈoʊnli slip naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不再說一個字，只睡覺。
